source.prompt: Pixel art sprite animation test footage, 32-bit era console style, crisp hard-edged pixels, limited palette, flat shading. The character stays EXACTLY the same design, proportions, colours and pixel scale as the first frame. Locked static camera, strict orthographic side view, no zoom, no pan, no camera motion. The background stays a perfectly flat solid pure bright green (#00FF00) with no shadow, no floor, no gradient, no particles, no impact flashes, no sparks, no motion lines, nothing else in frame. No text. The magma slime crawls in place facing right in a looping cycle: its body compresses, then stretches forward, bulging and settling, its surface rippling. It stays centred and does not travel across the screen. molten surface glowing through the cracks.
